main.description: Get hydrated views and raw associations for multiple Atmosphere records. Requires authentication. Roots may be latest or pinned to exact CIDs; dependencies are always latest.

uris.description: Complete DID-based AT-URIs, including collection and record key. Results preserve this order, including duplicates.

cids.description: Optional CIDs index-aligned with uris. When supplied, must have the same length as uris. Each entry must be a valid CID or the string 'latest' to select the latest version. Without cids, all roots are latest. Unavailable pins never fall back to latest.

views.description: Index-aligned with uris. Missing or invisible roots produce empty objects. Visible roots without a supported view still return raw associations. Each result includes only its own dependencies.

view.description: Hydrated view, present only when the records supply enough information to populate the required fields.

associatedRefs.description: The selected root followed by its visible latest dependencies: a document's publication or a gallery's items and photos. Index-aligned with associatedRecords.

associatedRecords.description: Raw record data, index-aligned with associatedRefs.
